references.title: Our History
observations: Riverside purchased an existing West Lafayette church building in April 2006.
The congregation identifies its current location as 1850 Woodland Avenue near Salisbury and Lindberg.
references.geometry_use: Identity/address corroboration only; no measured dimensions or facade plans.

references.title: Covenant Curch — West Lafayette, IN (2022)
observations: The 2022 renovation connected entry and sanctuary with full-glass doors.
The renovated lobby includes a coffee bar and lounge.
The sanctuary has theatrical scrims and textured partitions behind the stage.
The childcare area received new canopies at check-in.

local_images.observation: Long brick elevation, deep dark metal canopies, pale stone piers, clerestory and lower windows, paved entry walk.
Warm wood lobby floor, dark carpet zones, lounge seating, cafe tables, and open community room.
Sanctuary seating, tall stained-glass end window, exposed timber frame, side glazing and corridor.

references.geometry_use: Visual design evidence for exterior finish, canopies and interior program; photographs are not georeferenced, scaled elevations or whole-building floor plans.

references.provider: Church and States: Covenant Church, West Lafayette, Indiana (independent blog; original photographer not identified)
references.title: Covenant Church, West Lafayette, Indiana
observations: Entrance photo shows a low red-brown brick church, broad charcoal canopy, grouped glass doors, and a large triangular stained-glass window set in a pale A-frame surround above the roof line.
references.geometry_use: Historical visual reference only. Photographer/camera position and image scale are unknown; not treated as survey evidence.

modeling_limitations: The OSM outline and state LiDAR footprint are independent mapped outlines, not a measured structural-wall plan.
Canopy and entrance positions are estimated from oblique/unscaled photos; their campus-side bearing cannot be independently recovered.
Eaves, roof ridge and stained-glass peak heights are unverified estimates; no elevation drawing was found.
The KJG project photos support a lobby and sanctuary layout, but no whole-building floor plan, room dimensions or exact program boundaries are published.
